fileNodes.name: dom.js
fileNodes.summary: Shared DOM primitives (text normalization, element creation via textContent, and fail-loud id lookup) used by every UI component so package data is never parsed as HTML.

fileNodes.name: cards.js
fileNodes.summary: Renders the catalog grid: one card per visible entry with kind icon, publisher title and description, curated or declared category badge, and placeholder scan/token slots that say Not published.

fileNodes.name: categories.js
fileNodes.summary: Rebinds Catalog's curated category records to served index entries and exposes badge, note and count helpers, never inferring categories that Catalog did not curate.

fileNodes.name: collections.js
fileNodes.summary: Applies Catalog's published collection view to the index to decide which entries are current inventory, counting older entries only as diagnostics.

fileNodes.name: controller.js
fileNodes.summary: Sources & Catalogs feature controller that owns the single selection/filter state, loads the catalog, and wires all catalog components through models and callbacks.

fileNodes.name: details.js
fileNodes.summary: Renders the inspector's Details and Security tabs: publisher overview, declared capabilities, upstream provenance, evidence statements and Catalog qualification, with explicit absence wording.

fileNodes.name: elements.js
fileNodes.summary: Looks up all Sources & Catalogs DOM elements once and groups them per owning component so no component queries the DOM itself.

fileNodes.name: entry.js
fileNodes.summary: Pure readers over a single published catalog entry: source identity by source type, digests, labels, evidence statements, kind icons and search text.

fileNodes.name: index-source.js
fileNodes.summary: Loads the served @aihq/catalog index and preview summary, enforces the index format/version contract, and applies collections, publisher, qualification and category sidecars.

fileNodes.name: metrics.js
fileNodes.summary: Renders the six-kind ledger metric tiles above the split, counting only kinds the index carries and showing Not published for the rest.

fileNodes.name: navigation.js
fileNodes.summary: Renders the left-rail Catalog Scopes: one row per published source identity or Catalog collection, with revision markers, curated category breakdown and organization additions.

fileNodes.name: provenance.js
fileNodes.summary: Renders the installed-package provenance strip, the masthead naming the selected source, and the source status line, stating unconnected organization/Core state explicitly.

fileNodes.name: publisher.js
fileNodes.summary: Rebinds Catalog's publisher presentation metadata (titles, descriptions, categories) to index entries and reads it back with Catalog's own unavailability reasons.

fileNodes.name: qualification.js
fileNodes.summary: Rebinds Catalog's publisher qualification reader results to index entries, with tooltips for each state word and attestation sentences, never treating qualified as approval.

fileNodes.name: selectors.js
fileNodes.summary: Pure presentation selectors for search, filtering, sorting, inventory counts and source scopes, computing every displayed number from the installed index at run time.

fileNodes.name: toolbar.js
fileNodes.summary: Renders the filter toolbar: the primary review pills (with unavailable Needs Review/Egress Out) and secondary kind, source-type and sort controls with scroll affordance.

fileNodes.name: view-state.js
fileNodes.summary: Persists the catalog view (query, filters, sort) in sessionStorage and restores it validated against the installed index counts.

fileNodes.name: publisher-refusal.test.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Node test suite verifying that a refused publisher-metadata sidecar is reported with the reader's reason rather than as Catalog publishing nothing.

fileNodes.name: absence.js
fileNodes.summary: Defines the shared absence vocabulary (Not published, Not declared, Not supplied, Not connected) and related reason strings so the UI never conflates missing package data with missing operator input.

fileNodes.name: bytes.js
fileNodes.summary: Moves exact artifact bytes between files, the backend and browser downloads via Base64 without re-serializing, preserving the canonical bytes Core's parsers require.

fileNodes.name: controller.js
fileNodes.summary: Governance workflow controller that wires all pane components and transport calls into one vertical slice (select, inspect, import evidence, prepare, save, reopen, consume) while guarding every async answer with revision tokens so verdicts only reflect current inputs.

fileNodes.name: detector.js
fileNodes.summary: Renders scanner attestation, scanner result facts and detector provenance as three distinct statements in the Governance pane.

fileNodes.name: elements.js
fileNodes.summary: Collects the Governance pane's DOM elements by id and groups them by the component that owns each one.

fileNodes.name: inputs.js
fileNodes.summary: Component owning the subject readout, catalog details, evidence file input and decision/target/effect/route fields; exposes operator-supplied values without ever inventing missing ones.

fileNodes.name: observation.js
fileNodes.summary: Component collecting the operator's observation inputs (artifact manifest, install root and folder) and handing the bytes to the backend by path without parsing or hashing them.

fileNodes.name: operator-files.js
fileNodes.summary: Component for the operator's own authority, verifier trust and attestation material files, stored separately and never derived from imported evidence.

fileNodes.name: prepared.js
fileNodes.summary: Component owning the Prepare button, the prepared-artifact readout and exact-byte downloads, showing binding only as a claim until independent consumption.

fileNodes.name: reopen.js
fileNodes.summary: Component that reopens the two downloaded files in a fresh session so consumption re-derives the verdict independently from the exact bytes.

fileNodes.name: revisions.js
fileNodes.summary: Revision tracker that assigns a revision per verification input slot and session so asynchronous answers minted under stale inputs are discarded.

fileNodes.name: rows.js
fileNodes.summary: Provides the single label/value row renderer used across Governance displays, rendering null values as an explicit absence word.

fileNodes.name: statuses.js
fileNodes.summary: Renders the six verification status axes as six separate cells in contract order, never collapsing them into one badge.

fileNodes.name: transport.js
fileNodes.summary: HTTP transport layer for every Governance call to the preview backend's /api endpoints, passing operator input through unchanged and returning Core's answers.

fileNodes.name: verdict.js
fileNodes.summary: Component owning the Consume button and verdict readout, including assessment binding, observation results and the mandatory execution sentence.

fileNodes.name: vocabulary.js
fileNodes.summary: Defines the words the Governance pane may use: the six status axes, tone mappings and refusal wording, with rules forbidding Applied/Installed/Executed language.

fileNodes.name: revisions.test.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Unit tests for the revision tracker covering slot tokens, session changes, selection changes and undefined-slot errors.

fileNodes.name: scan-attribution-cases.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Acceptance cases for Scan signer attribution: signs a fixture with the second of two trusted keys carrying different operator declarations, reorders roots, and asserts the verifier attributes the declaration of the actual signer.

fileNodes.name: artifacts.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Exact-byte artifact I/O for the backend worker: base64 helpers, byte-exact read/write/copy of files and trees, JSON file helpers, and session-relative path naming so the page never sees machine paths.

fileNodes.name: catalog-access.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Reads the installed @aihq/catalog through Catalog's published content reader, resolving the package root, looking up entries, joining descriptor paths safely, and reporting Catalog's own integrity result.

fileNodes.name: catalog-assessment.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Builds the optional assessment resolver handed to Core, supplying only the published Catalog assessment artifact bytes for the identity Core derived.

fileNodes.name: catalog-categories.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Serves Catalog's curated per-entry categories through readCatalogCategoriesV1, reporting refusals rather than assigning or inferring categories.

fileNodes.name: catalog-collections.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Serves Catalog's current collection view through readCatalogCollectionsV1, bound to the exact index bytes; loaded on demand by the worker.

fileNodes.name: catalog-publisher.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Serves publisher titles, descriptions and categories from Catalog's display-only presentation sidecar via readCatalogPresentationV1, reporting unavailable values with Catalog's reason.

fileNodes.name: catalog-qualification.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Serves Catalog's publisher qualification states via readCatalogQualificationV1, which re-verifies the shipped signed head and receipts, stamped with the instant they hold at.

fileNodes.name: catalog-served.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Projects the output of Catalog's public content reader member by member into the document served to the page, so no field the reader drops can reach the UI.

fileNodes.name: core-adapter.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Calls @aihq/core's public API for subject derivation, evidence parsing, preparation and independent consumption of governance input, wiring in the Catalog assessment resolver and Scan verification without reproducing Core logic.

fileNodes.name: core-service.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Backend worker entry point and operation dispatcher: reads one JSON request on stdin, routes it to catalog, Core or validation operations (some lazily imported), and writes one JSON response.

fileNodes.name: fixture-candidate.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Validation-only builder that assembles a ScanCandidateV2 over the installed Catalog content and signs it with an ephemeral key; no detector runs and nothing is a measurement.

fileNodes.name: scan-verifier.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Builds the Scan verifier adapter injected into Core consumption from @aihq/scan's public exports and the operator's own trust file, enforcing the trust boundary and attributing operator declarations to the verified signer.

fileNodes.name: validation-fixture.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Explicitly labelled validation mode: the only module that manufactures anything, producing an ephemeral signed scan candidate, example authority bundle and operator trust file for a Catalog entry.

fileNodes.name: catalog-served.test.mjs
fileNodes.summary: node:test cases asserting the served catalog document carries only members of the public reader's result types and serves the evidence summary exactly when the reader returned it.

fileNodes.name: session-relative.test.mjs
fileNodes.summary: node:test cases pinning that operator-side files are named by session-relative path for both path styles, and never by machine location.

fileNodes.name: catalog-index-contract.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Defines the published catalog-index contract (format name and version) that the preview enforces before serving a resolved catalog index.

fileNodes.name: check-page-contract.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Offline regression script verifying that every element id the page modules collect exists exactly once in src/index.html, that the relative module graph and page assets resolve to copied files, and that request paths classify correctly (200/400/403).

fileNodes.name: check-scan-attribution.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Integration check that installs the three local package tarballs into a throwaway consumer, copies the backend service in, and asserts signer attribution rules (declaration follows the actual signer, ordering independence, unattributed and ambiguous trust cases).

fileNodes.name: packages.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Resolves @aihq/core, @aihq/scan and @aihq/catalog into tarballs, either from supplied *_TGZ files or by git-archiving a committed checkpoint into an external workspace, building, packing and caching by commit, then installs them into a throwaway consumer.

fileNodes.name: preview-request.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Classifies a raw preview request URL into a served file path or a 400/403 refusal, kept separate from the server so malformed-URL and traversal behavior can be tested without starting a preview.

fileNodes.name: preview.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Entry point that builds a throwaway Policy Workbench preview: resolves and installs the three packages into a consumer, copies page, service and presentation assets into an external run directory, validates the catalog index contract, and serves the static page plus API on 127.0.0.1.

fileNodes.name: api.mjs
fileNodes.summary: HTTP API routing for the preview: maps GET/POST /api/* routes (packages, subject, catalog-integrity, evidence, validation-fixture, operator-file, observation, reopen, prepare, consume, saved) to service calls and session storage, keeping filesystem paths server-side.

fileNodes.name: assets.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Determines which files the preview copies where: discovers served page assets by walking src/, lists service modules and flat presentation assets, and asserts required entry points are readable.

fileNodes.name: service-client.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Seam between the preview server and the installed packages: runs the service worker as a child process inside the consumer and exchanges one JSON request for one JSON response.

fileNodes.name: sessions.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Server-owned session store deriving every filesystem location from an opaque uuid, holding operator-supplied files (authority bundle, trust, attestation material) and revision-guarded observation uploads outside the consume root.

fileNodes.name: static.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Static half of the preview server: lets the API handler claim /api paths first, then serves run-directory files via classifyRequestPath with MIME types and 400/403/404 answers.

fileNodes.name: sessions-observation.test.mjs
fileNodes.summary: node:test suite for the session store's observation revision guard: older or equal revisions are refused without touching bytes, missing revisions are refused, inputs and sessions are counted independently, and unknown sessions are rejected first.

fileNodes.name: ai-tools.js
fileNodes.summary: Header AI tools control that lists the AI CLI targets @aihq/core publishes as supported, keeps the user's selection as a browser-local draft, and never implies installation or connection status.

fileNodes.name: elements.js
fileNodes.summary: Looks up the DOM nodes owned by the application shell, the organization setup popup and the AI tools control by element id.

fileNodes.name: organization.js
fileNodes.summary: Organization setup popup in the header: a user-entered draft (name, short id, policy repo, emails, signing posture) persisted in localStorage, validated on save and discarded on cancel, with no claim of policy authority.

fileNodes.name: shell.js
fileNodes.summary: Application shell controller owning the collapsible navigation and inspector rails, keyboard-accessible inspector tabs and the error banner, exposing openInspector and showError to features.

fileNodes.name: theme.js
fileNodes.summary: Observes theme changes on <html> and briefly suppresses CSS transitions so already-rendered elements repaint against the new theme variables instead of keeping stale colours.

fileNodes.name: main.js
fileNodes.summary: Policy Workbench page entry point that composes the shell, theme, AI tools, organization, catalog and governance features and wires their callbacks together without holding state.

fileNodes.name: AGENTS.md
fileNodes.summary: Six working rules for agents in this repo: own only the Policy Workbench screens, build from prototype/ without redesigning it, use only the public interfaces of @aihq/core, @aihq/catalog and @aihq/scan, ship a clickable page first, keep no plan documents, and never publish or force-push without the owner's approval.

fileNodes.name: CLAUDE.md
fileNodes.summary: One-line Claude Code instruction file that pulls in AGENTS.md by reference, so both agent tools follow the same repo rules.

fileNodes.name: README.md
fileNodes.summary: The authoritative project README. It states what the repo owns and must never contain, how the page is composed (app shell, catalog, governance), layout parity with the prototype, the Governance pane's slice through Core, how to run the preview, and the rules for reading published packages.

fileNodes.name: admin-acme.html
fileNodes.summary: Admin prototype screen for "Acme additions": the organization's own source listing internal MCP servers, skills and tools with their scan status, and the only place an admin runs a scan themselves.

fileNodes.name: admin-changes.html
fileNodes.summary: Admin prototype screen showing the staged policy delta (acme.policy.json) as a colorized JSON diff against the template, with reset, copy, download and publish actions.

fileNodes.name: admin-item.html
fileNodes.summary: Admin prototype screen for a single catalog item's security view (fal-ai-media), showing findings, per-scanner results and source evidence behind a needs-review hold.

fileNodes.name: admin-org.html
fileNodes.summary: Admin prototype first-run screen where the organization identifies itself (name, id, policy repo, owners prefilled from git) alongside the five-step onboarding path.

fileNodes.name: admin-scan.html
fileNodes.summary: Admin prototype scan-review screen summarizing scan results across every aih-shipped source (passed, needs review, not scanned) with grouping and an explanation of what each result means.

fileNodes.name: admin-sources.html
fileNodes.summary: The owner's final, self-contained admin Sources prototype: a full workbench layout with a collapsible nav rail, source card grid, item inspector drawer (details, security scan, policy JSON tabs), organization modal and theme toggle; the origin of the shared tokens and base styles.

fileNodes.name: entry.html
fileNodes.summary: Prototype landing screen shown when the workbench command runs in a folder that is neither a policy repo nor a project, letting the operator choose the admin page or the user page.

fileNodes.name: fonts.css
fileNodes.summary: Imports the Inter, JetBrains Mono and Material Symbols Outlined web fonts from Google Fonts for every prototype screen.

fileNodes.name: overview.html
fileNodes.summary: Prototype overview explaining who uses the workbench: the two doors (admin and user), what aih ships, and the two plain policy files that travel between organization and project repos.

fileNodes.name: system.html
fileNodes.summary: Design-system reference screen showcasing the shared tokens and components: colour roles, type, actions and controls, labels/status/filters, navigation and cards.

fileNodes.name: tokens.css
fileNodes.summary: Design tokens for the Policy Workbench extracted from admin-sources.html: colour-role CSS custom properties for dark (default) and light modes plus typography conventions.

fileNodes.name: user-start.html
fileNodes.summary: User-side prototype screen for picking a starting policy for a project (payments-api) and explaining how a trimmed aih-project-policy.json is shared with teammates via aih init --apply.

fileNodes.name: user-trim.html
fileNodes.summary: Interactive user-side prototype for trimming an organization policy: users toggle sources and items by kind, see ledger counts, overlap and broken-link warnings, and a change log before saving the project policy.

fileNodes.name: wb.css
fileNodes.summary: Shared base styles for every prototype screen, lifted from admin-sources.html: full-height layout, thin scrollbars, collapsible panel transitions and small utility classes driven by tokens.css variables.

fileNodes.name: index.html
fileNodes.summary: Design-source index of the Policy Workbench prototype: a navigable deck that frames each prototype screen in an iframe with Back/Next controls, notes on the single design system, and a light/dark mode switch.

fileNodes.name: mode.js
fileNodes.summary: Light/dark mode switcher shared by prototype screens: picks the mode from ?mode, then localStorage, then dark, and toggles the html class and any mode-toggle button labels and icons.

fileNodes.name: shell.js
fileNodes.summary: Defines the global WB object that injects the shared admin chrome (header, sub-header, nav rail) from admin-sources.html into prototype admin screens via WB.top() and WB.nav().

fileNodes.name: tw-config.js
fileNodes.summary: Tailwind CDN configuration shared by every prototype screen and the Workbench page: class-based dark mode and a Material-style color palette mapped to tokens.css custom properties.

fileNodes.name: user-shell.js
fileNodes.summary: Defines the global WBU object rendering the user-facing page chrome, including the organization-policy strip that illustrates the policy lookup order (--policy, AIH_ORG_POLICY, aih-org-policy.json) selectable via ?source.

fileNodes.name: workbench.css
fileNodes.summary: Local presentation rules the Workbench page adds on top of the prototype stylesheets: Material Symbols axes, a hidden-scrollbar fading kind-filter strip, provenance marker hiding, and theme-change transition handling.

fileNodes.name: index.html
fileNodes.summary: Main HTML page of the Policy Workbench: loads fonts, tokens, mode and Tailwind config, prototype and local stylesheets, and defines every element (masthead, source rails, catalog ledger, governance pane, organization modal) that main.js wires up.

fileNodes.name: acceptance-sweep.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Browserless acceptance sweep against a running preview's /api/* endpoints, replaying the Governance pane's call order to check no filesystem paths leak, session sharing, reopen round-trips, and refusal of bad sessions or bodies.

fileNodes.name: compare.html
fileNodes.summary: Layout-parity tool that renders the prototype and the implementation side by side or overlaid (difference blend) at the same 1600x1000 viewport to compare element geometry.

fileNodes.name: inspect-dom.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Reads a headless-rendered DOM dump of the preview page and prints acceptance facts such as the catalog error element, masthead, provenance strip, counts, and source rails.

fileNodes.name: probe-http.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Sends raw byte-exact HTTP requests over a socket to the preview server with malformed and traversal paths, then confirms the server still serves the catalog index afterwards.

fileNodes.name: probe-old-handler.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Reproduces the malformed-URL bug by running the pre-fix static server handler (unguarded decodeURIComponent) on a throwaway port and sending raw requests to it.

fileNodes.name: probe-shell-quoting.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Throwaway probe checking how spawnSync with and without shell:true quotes a JavaScript expression argument on the current platform.

fileNodes.name: core-targets.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Service module exposing the AI CLI targets Core supports, read from @aihq/core's public SUPPORTED_CLIS export and validated; loaded on demand by core-service.mjs.
